title: Coast Guard Rescues Dolphin
description: Coast Guard crewmembers aboard a 29-foot Response Boat-Small II, from Station Fort Myers Beach, Florida, rescue a distressed dolphin after it landed in a boat near Back Bay, Thursday, July 21, 2016. The Coast Guard coordinated with a Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission marine biologist who determined the dolphin should be placed back into the water as quickly as possible to ensure the dolphin's survival. U.S. Coast Guard video by Seaman Chris Epperson
